sourceCoverageNote: The regenerated set includes all 63 campuses at FIRE 2025 ranks 189–251 and the 23 campuses explicitly named in Chronicle's May 2024 examples, deduplicated to 75 IPEDS identities. The hotbed tag is an estimate from those proxies; FIRE measures speech climate and tolerance, not activism frequency, while the Chronicle event set concerns Gaza encampments and is not a complete transcription of all 50 encampments.
